items.title: Netflix Launches First AI-Branded Content Recommendations Feature on TVs
items.excerpt: Netflix is introducing AI Discover, a new tab on its TV app that lets subscribers explore titles through AI-generated themes such as "Something Light" or "Scare Me", a test bed for conversational discovery.

items.title: Netflix will show you themed recommendations through a new 'AI Discover' tab
items.excerpt: Netflix's new AI Discover tab on TVs groups titles under AI-generated mood themes; The Verge looks at how the interface works and whether it actually helps viewers pick something.

items.title: CAA's Bryan Lourd Discusses AI As Agency Weighs In On NYT Vs. OpenAI Battle
items.excerpt: CAA filed in the New York Times v. OpenAI copyright case with major stars on board, and co-chairman Bryan Lourd laid out what AI should be allowed to train on and what it should pay for. A new filing, not commentary.

items.title: WME Joins New York Times Copyright Battle Against OpenAI
items.excerpt: WME filed in the NYT v. OpenAI case, saying it does not oppose AI but wants licensed, "ethical & responsible" AI for its clients and creators.

items.title: Cate Blanchett-Backed Group and Hollywood Stars File Brief in New York Times-OpenAI Lawsuit
items.excerpt: The Human Consent Foundation, a nonprofit backed by Cate Blanchett, and a group of Hollywood stars filed a brief arguing that Hollywood already has "proven infrastructure" for licensing content to AI.

items.title: Ava DuVernay Defends Using AI in New Doc '14th'
items.excerpt: DuVernay used AI to animate public-domain archival photos in her birthright-citizenship documentary '14th'. She says no person, avatar or voice was fabricated and that the technique brings viewers closer to history.

items.title: iZotope Intros Photon for AI-Powered Stem Separation and Denoising
items.excerpt: iZotope's Photon is a standalone app and ARA plugin that separates stems and cleans up dialogue with 12 custom-trained ML models. It runs locally on the GPU, so post-audio teams don't have to upload files.

items.title: New iZotope Photon powered by 12 machine-learning models
items.excerpt: PVC's take on iZotope Photon: GPU-accelerated stem separation and denoising for video editors, powered by 12 custom-trained models running on the desktop.

items.title: New AI-Assisted Retopology Software Launches For PC
items.excerpt: Sparseal has released CozyBlanket Pro, an AI-assisted retopology app for Windows and macOS that automates cleaning up 3D meshes, a routine step in modeling pipelines.

items.title: From AI generation to final cut, Fotor Agent takes on the video production workflow
items.excerpt: Fotor Agent turns a text brief into an organized video project that combines visuals, subtitles, audio and animation. Its editable timeline lets users revise single elements without regenerating the whole clip.

items.title: ByteDance Is Rewiring Its AI Video Bet
items.excerpt: ByteDance's CapCut unit has folded its AI video-creation app Xiaoyunque into Jimeng while keeping Xiaoyunque's agent-style workflow, consolidating its AI video tools for creators.

items.title: China's First AI Feature Earns Just $253,000 In 11 Days
items.excerpt: 'Sanxingdui: Future Past', China's first fully AI-generated theatrical feature, reportedly cost $1.5 million and grossed just $253,000 in its first 11 days. Forecasts say it won't reach a third of its budget.

items.title: China's first AI-generated film is a flop. Some still see it as the future of cinema
items.excerpt: Sanxingdui: Future Past has flopped at the box office, yet Chinese investors and studios keep putting money into AI filmmaking. The Guardian looks at why the industry still sees it as cinema's future.

items.title: SAG-AFTRA Members Ratify TV Animation Contracts
items.excerpt: SAG-AFTRA members ratified both TV animation agreements with the AMPTP by 94.95% to 5.05%, securing a 12.6% wage increase, stronger AI protections for voice actors and better residuals through June 2030.

items.title: Hallmark Fans Are Furious Over The Alleged Use Of AI In New Christmas Movie
items.excerpt: Viewers of Hallmark's new Christmas movie 'Adopting St. Nick' say its signs and props look AI-generated, which has set off a backlash over AI use in production design.

items.title: Expression Sheet - Luma
items.excerpt: Luma launched Expression Sheet, a feature that lets creators explore the range of a character's facial performance across many expressions before committing to a direction.

items.title: AI가 만든 '임권택 스타일' 영화 공개…대한민국예술원 영화전
items.excerpt: 대한민국예술원 영화전(11월 5~6일, 서울영화센터)에서 AI가 임권택 감독의 영화를 학습한 뒤 그 스타일로 연출한 단편 '확인'이 처음 공개된다. 중단편 AI 영화 우수작 8편도 상영한다.
